reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and it does most of what I need when I paste things in. I can't see what three 'AI managers' would do for me that's worth another 99 euros a month and another login to learn.

would_change_my_mind: A demo on my own data showing it actually doing a job end to end, like answering our support emails or chasing leads, with the setup done for me in an afternoon.
